title: 3v3 Sideline Out-of-Bounds Game
description: A half-court 3v3 that always restarts from a sideline inbound, practising entries, denial and quick decisions under a five-second count.

content.objective: Get the ball inbounded safely and into a good attacking position before the five-second count expires.
content.setup: Every possession starts with a sideline inbound against three defenders denying the catch.
instructions: The inbounder has five seconds to find a teammate and get the ball in.
Teammates cut and relocate to get open for the inbound pass.
Once inbounded, play live 3v3 to a score or a defensive stop.
Rotate which team inbounds after every possession.
coachingPoints: Move immediately to get open; standing still invites a five-second violation.
Inbounder should pivot to see the whole floor, not just one target.
Play with urgency once the ball is in — don't waste the advantage of a clean inbound.
commonMistakes: Standing still and letting the defense deny every target.
Panicking near the five-second mark and forcing a bad pass.
Playing at a walk-through pace instead of real game speed.
content.safety: Denial defenders use hands and body only, no grabbing a cutter's jersey.
